scope: Packet22b (CR17/d): packet22 (stateless shared search, isolated reads) plus a process-wide one-slot gate (database.shared_read_session, non-reentrant) around the isolated reads of shared searches, so they add at most one connection next to the request Sessions.
fixtures_note: Fixtures reused unchanged from cr17d-after-v1 (same sha256; provider-constructor adapter and GC-controlled colds). Pre-registration wiring smoke on 22b (smoke_cr17e_wiring.py, 5 runs: 4 fixtures --fixture-smoke + --profile-smoke, after only; before was smoked for cr17d): only exit code, gc_collections presence and no external HTTP were checked; timings and memory were not read. Exploratory pool pre-screen (cr17d-pool-diagnostic-v1 fixture, 2 runs per arm) read connection counts and memory to choose the candidate; those runs are not gate data.
sampling: Serial. smoke(after,before) -> short 2x5 paired before/after (AB/BA alternating) + 5 rotated ABC references (reference fixture) -> direct 2x5 paired + 5 rotated ABC -> kodi 2x5 paired + 5 rotated ABC -> long: 3 contemporaneous full1800s/60cycle pairs, order after,before / before,after / after,before. 12 cells x 100 requests per short run. Cold and warmup separate. Every attempt retained; failures recorded, never rerun or replaced.
acceptance: PASS only if every gate check passes. Ownership (primary): C Kodi series 0 DetachedInstanceError, only HTTP 200, all 10 runs complete; C direct series all 10 runs complete (fixture aborts on any non-200). Functional: C smoke/short/direct/kodi/long complete, no external HTTP, identical normalized payload/order/count per cell (Kodi on error-free rows), long quiescence/pool0/background0. Timing/resources (V6 thresholds unchanged): short and direct cohort medians, heap run medians each <= HTTP p95 max(before medians)+10ms, CPU max*1.10, memory max+2MiB (RSS +2048KiB), SQL <= max before value; strict metrics (cold wall, loop lag, file bytes) <= max(before values)+J, J=max-min of before group medians. Heap before = the 3 fresh packet21b runs, after = the 3 C runs, every after run median within limit. Observations, not gates: Kodi timing, A/B/C reference timing, A failures (expected preexisting DetachedInstanceError), contemporaneous paired heap p95 differences, gen2 cold phases, heap trend. Any failure stays open; no threshold change or waiver after results.
resources: Local desktop-linux npipe, network none, read-only frozen app mount, tmpfs disposable synthetic DB, no dotenv/real credentials. short/direct/kodi/references CPU8,9; long CPU6,7; 2 CPU/1GiB each; strictly serial; no other Docker benchmark during this protocol.
